name: product-page
title: Product page
description: The product page template, built only from library items: the deck cover's hero, one section per thing the product does (search, the brief, the category, adding a brand, agents), copy and picture side by side, and the offer.
use_for: A website's product tour. Each section is a library item beside a headline from the assets; reorder or drop them.
never: New colors, shadows or type sizes added to a section: use the items' props
More than one White button in a section
A section without a picture from the library
source: Built from the library (site header, hero block, creative row, search bar, creative grid, card, stat block, creative ring, offer block, footer row); Figma page 8: Pitch deck cover, Curved strip; the headlines are the posts' and ads' own

import { html, nothing, type TemplateResult } from 'lit' import { DsElement, define, HostLayoutController } from '@/elements/lib/element' import { productContent, type ProductContent } from '@/lib/pages/product' import '@/elements/components/ui/button' import '@/elements/components/ui/card' import '@/elements/components/product/search-bar' import '@/elements/components/site/creative-grid' import '@/elements/components/site/creative-ring' import '@/elements/components/site/creative-row' import '@/elements/components/site/footer-row' import '@/elements/components/site/site-header' import '@/elements/components/blocks/hero-block' import '@/elements/components/blocks/offer-block' import '@/elements/components/blocks/stat-block' import '@/elements/components/visuals/logo' import styles from 'virtual:tw' // ProductPage.tsx as : the deck cover's hero, one section per thing the product does (copy and // picture side by side, alternating) and the offer. `content` replaces the copy. const WRAP = 'mx-auto w-full max-w-page-wide px-12 max-sm:px-4' const split = (headline: string, body: string | undefined, reverse: boolean, media: TemplateResult) => html`

${headline}

${body ? html`

${body}

` : nothing}
${media}
` /** * @summary The product page template. */ export class ProductPage extends DsElement { static styles = [DsElement.styles, styles] protected readonly layout = new HostLayoutController(this, () => this.renderRoot.querySelector('[data-ds="product-page"]')) static properties = { content: { type: Object } } /** The page's copy (lib/pages/product.ts by default). */ content: ProductContent = productContent render() { const c = this.content ?? productContent return html`
${c.hero.action.label} ${split(c.search.headline, c.search.body, false, html`
`)} ${split(c.brief.headline, c.brief.body, true, html`
    ${c.brief.card.lines.map((l) => html`
  • ${l}
    • `)}
`)} ${split(c.category.headline, c.category.body, false, html``)} ${split(c.add.headline, undefined, true, html``)} ${split(c.agents.headline, undefined, false, html``)}
` } } define('product-page', ProductPage)
